title: Synergistic enhancement of the properties of composite solid electrolytes via PAN and in situ SiO2 for all-solid-state lithium batteries
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6YA00033A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hun Lee, Sung Yeon Hwang
PAN and in situ-generated SiO2 synergistically reduce the PEO crystallinity and promote ion transport. The composite electrolyte exhibits enhanced ion conductivity, interfacial stability, and stable cycling, with suppressed lithium dendrite growth.
